title: MCShowdown
description: Showdown is an minecraft event server where the community plays minigames together in teams of 4 to try and win and ofc have a lot of fun!
body:
Showdown is an minecraft event server where the community plays minigames together in teams of 4 to try and win and ofc have a lot of fun!

You need the latest version of the Showdium mod to join the server:
https://modrinth.com/mod/showdium
